comparator.name: Computing Science
comparator.sourceNotes: Years one and two each contain 60 EC of required courses. The third year has a 30 EC free minor space, 15 EC of required courses and a 15 EC bachelor’s project.
components: Algorithms and Data Structures in C (for CS)
Introduction to Computer Graphics and Visualization

core: Programming, software design and multi-language development
Algorithms, computational problem solving and formal reasoning
Computer architecture, networks and secure systems
Data analysis, digital innovation and computational modelling
adjacent: Responsible computing, research and technical communication
questions: How are reliable software and digital systems designed, built and evaluated?
How do formal and mathematical methods organize efficient computation?
How can data-driven and intelligent systems be developed responsibly?

selection.assessment: The direct interests support one computing response across systems, algorithms, software and mathematical methods. A data and AI emphasis is already represented within it. A second option would reuse most of the same technical curriculum or shift into other fields without an independently supported programme-level direction.

notes.text: UCR combines substantial computing with a broader liberal arts and sciences curriculum. Groningen requires separate courses in computer architecture, web engineering, security and distributed systems, and a bachelor’s project.

alternatives.label: Computer systems, software and algorithms
alternatives.concept: Develops programming and software design alongside algorithms, networks, operating systems and databases. Mathematics, statistics and data science support later work in optimisation and machine learning.
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum has substantive programming, systems, software and algorithms, supported by mathematics and data science.
progression: Python and discrete mathematics precede algorithms, followed by advanced algorithms and C++ and Haskell development. Mathematical methods and linear algebra support numerical methods, signals and advanced calculus. Introductory data analysis precedes machine learning and deep learning.

audience.programmeDescription: Computing Science at the University of Groningen studies how software and computer systems work and how to design them. It combines programming and algorithms with mathematics, systems and a required research project.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR option concentrates on software, algorithms and systems, with applications in data science and machine learning.

componentNotes.y3-free-minor: Students can use this space for eligible electives, a minor or an approved study period. An internship can use part of the 30 EC.
componentNotes.y3-bachelor-project: The project follows the first-year curriculum and at least 75 EC from years two and three.
